subject.title: fix(canvas): reject oversized A2UI JSONL files before dispatch

question: Should Canvas preserve the complete Gateway-compatible payload range, or is a new fixed 64 KiB safety reserve an intentional compatibility change?
rationale: The patch fixes an availability problem, but choosing a smaller public Canvas ceiling affects existing users and cannot be inferred solely from the transport constant.

options.title: Preserve the transport range
options.body: Move or expose exact outgoing-frame size validation at the Gateway boundary and keep the bounded reader from rejecting payloads that the negotiated transport still accepts.

options.title: Approve the smaller ceiling
options.body: Explicitly accept the 64 KiB contraction, document the Canvas-specific limit, and add boundary proof showing the intended upgrade behavior.

recommendation.title: Preserve the transport range
recommendation.body: Move or expose exact outgoing-frame size validation at the Gateway boundary and keep the bounded reader from rejecting payloads that the negotiated transport still accepts.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent work establishes the current Canvas plugin ownership and its CLI/tool architecture.
